sources.citation: Bollaert, Flore. 2017. The synchronic phonology and nominal morphology of Sagala (Bantu G39, Tanzania): a preliminary study. MA thesis, Universiteit Gent (supervision BantUGent, K. Bostoen). 68 pp.
sources.tag: likely states stress; not yet obtained
sources.access_detail: not located online or in the libraries checked
sources.note: The only descriptive work on Sagala G39 known to Glottolog (its Glottolog's most extensive description, doctype phonology); a 'synchronic phonology' chapter of a toneless-area Ruvu language will almost certainly state whether there is (penultimate) stress and/or tone. Not in UGent's catalogue or bibliography; Hammarstrom holds a private PDF (hh: africa/); cited without URL by Zahran & Dom 2024. Obtain from the author / BantUGent (Ghent) or H. Hammarstrom.
